badge.name: Explorer
badge.description: Knows when a task deserves an agent.

card.title: Is it agent-worthy?
lines: A clear group of people needs it
There is a trusted source for the answer
The outcome is clear (answer, ticket, order…)
No sensitive judgement calls about people

steps.title: Your mission
steps.text:
Contoso Coffee has **120 cafés** and one big problem: everyone asks the same questions again and again.

You are the new **Agent Builder team**. In each level you solve one Contoso problem.

- Answer questions to earn **XP**
- Finish a level to win a **badge** and a **cheat card**
- 3 correct in a row = **combo bonus** 🔥
- Stuck? Use a **hint** (costs 5 XP) or **50/50**

steps.question: Warm-up: should you just ask Copilot, or build an agent?

items.text: Summarize the long email thread I got this morning
Answer baristas' HR questions 24/7 in Teams, always from the HR handbook
Rewrite my paragraph so it sounds more polite
Check the status of a supply order and update the ticket
Brainstorm 5 names for a new seasonal drink
Guide every new hire through the same onboarding steps

steps.explain: Copilot is great for **your own one-off tasks**. An agent pays off when **many people** need the **same kind of help** from the **same trusted source** – or when something needs to **take action** in a system.

steps.question: Agent-worthy or not? Decide for each idea.

cards.text: Answer the same 50 HR questions baristas ask every week
cards.why: Repeated, clear audience, trusted source – a perfect first agent.

cards.text: Write one birthday message for a colleague
cards.why: A one-off task. Just ask Copilot.

cards.text: Help store managers order supplies from the ordering system
cards.why: Repeated task with a clear action in a system – agents can call tools.
A sensitive judgement about people. Keep humans in charge.

cards.text: Walk new hires through their first-week checklist
cards.why: Same steps for everyone – consistent and easy to measure.

cards.text: Something that only one person asks once a year
cards.why: Not worth building, testing and maintaining an agent.

steps.question: Which task is the BEST first agent for Contoso Coffee?
options: A one-time creative brainstorm for the marketing team
Answering frequent shift and vacation questions from the HR handbook
Choosing which store manager gets a bonus
steps.hint: Think: often + many people + trusted source.
steps.explain: Frequent questions + clear audience + one trusted source = a great first agent.
